in_marathi.name: Dharmander
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Righteous, just, and virtuous
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmander हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharmander is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'dharma' and 'andar'. Dharma means righteousness, morality, and law, while andar means within. Thus, Dharmander signifies one who embodies righteousness and virtues from within.
